Failure_Cause: Internal ADC multiplexer latch-up or reference drift
Local_Effect: Incorrect frozen cell voltage reported to MCU
System_Effect: Cell overvoltage or undervoltage may remain undetected
Detection_Mechanism: Measurement plausibility check; redundant HW comparator; open-wire diagnostic
Fault_Reaction: Flag voltage invalid; set MaxChargeCurrent to 0 A; open HV contactors if critical
Mitigation_Strategy: Independent HW overvoltage comparator path alongside primary ADC acquisition
Verification: Fault-injection test (stuck ADC value on HiL)

Failure_Cause: Broken wire harness or cracked NTC thermistor solder joint
Local_Effect: ADC input pulled to supply rail (invalid out-of-range reading)
System_Effect: Unsafe battery overtemperature may not be detected
Detection_Mechanism: Hardware pull-up/pull-down out-of-range detection; spatial plausibility check
Fault_Reaction: Substitute worst-case max temperature; log sensor DTC; apply progressive thermal derating
Mitigation_Strategy: Ratiometric pull-up bias network with out-of-range diagnostic thresholds
Verification: Open-circuit fault injection on sensor harness

Failure_Cause: Hall element gain drift or shunt amplifier offset shift
Local_Effect: Incorrect pack current magnitude reported to MCU
System_Effect: Incorrect charge/discharge limits or missed overcurrent condition
Detection_Mechanism: Dual-channel cross-check plausibility; zero-current offset check when contactors open
Fault_Reaction: Flag current plausibility fault; freeze coulomb counting; clamp current limits
Mitigation_Strategy: Redundant sensing channel and model-based dV/dt plausibility validation
Verification: Current sensor offset/gain fault injection on HiL

Failure_Cause: Infinite loop; stack overflow; clock drift; double-bit RAM/Flash error
Local_Effect: Control and diagnostic tasks stop executing or corrupt outputs
System_Effect: Loss of BMS monitoring; contactor control; and safety reactions
Detection_Mechanism: External window watchdog; ECC memory protection; program-flow monitoring
Fault_Reaction: External watchdog asserts hardware SAFE_STATE_N pin to disable contactor drivers
Mitigation_Strategy: Independent hardware watchdog reset and hardware safe-state disable path
Verification: Watchdog timeout & program-flow fault injection test

Failure_Cause: High inrush current during closure or opening under heavy load
Local_Effect: Contactor main contacts remain physically fused closed when coil de-energized
System_Effect: HV galvanic isolation unavailable on demand or during shutdown
Detection_Mechanism: Active contactor weld check (voltage across pole & auxiliary mirror contacts)
Fault_Reaction: Open opposite healthy contactor pole; latch critical weld DTC; inhibit future startup
Mitigation_Strategy: Dual-pole contactor architecture (Main+ and Main-) plus pre-charge circuit
Verification: Simulated welded contactor test during startup/shutdown

Failure_Cause: CAN transceiver failure; bus-off condition; VCU node reset
Local_Effect: Missing periodic vehicle commands or stale transmitted battery limits
System_Effect: Incorrect or unavailable control information between BMS and VCU/OBC
Detection_Mechanism: E2E timeout monitoring; rolling alive counter; CRC checksum validation
Fault_Reaction: Set MaxCharge/DischargeCurrent to 0 A; transition to safe isolated state after grace period
Mitigation_Strategy: E2E communication protection profile and deterministic communication-loss fallback state
Verification: CAN message drop and bus-off fault injection test

Failure_Cause: MOSFET short-circuit failure in high-side or low-side driver stage
Local_Effect: Unintended coil energization or inability to energize coil
System_Effect: Unintended HV bus energization or unintended HV disconnection
Detection_Mechanism: Coil current feedback monitoring; dual-switch (HS + LS) driver topology
Fault_Reaction: Disable complementary driver switch; log driver fault DTC; broadcast HV state to VCU
Mitigation_Strategy: Series high-side and low-side driver architecture gated by hardware HVIL loop
Verification: Hardware short-circuit fault injection on driver stage

Failure_Cause: Internal watchdog timer oscillator failure or output pin short
Local_Effect: Watchdog fails to assert SAFE_STATE_N when MCU hangs
System_Effect: Latent loss of MCU execution supervision during subsequent MCU fault
Detection_Mechanism: Startup watchdog self-test (forced missed trigger test during SelfTest state)
Fault_Reaction: Inhibit transition from SelfTest to Standby if watchdog fail-safe test fails
Mitigation_Strategy: Periodic startup challenge-response verification before closing HV contactors
